words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.ex: He will call you at the end of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议结束时给你打电话。
words.en: Indicates the final part of a period of time, an event, a process, or a physical object.

words.tr: phrase. 对面的；对立的；相反的
words.ex: The park is opposite to the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园在学校的对面。
words.en: in a position on the other side of a specific area from something; facing.

words.ex_cn: 他离准备好还很远。
words.en: If something is far from a particular thing or quality, it is not that thing or quality at all.

words.ex_cn: 商店离我家很近。
words.en: To be in close proximity to a place or person.

words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会回他的家乡。
words.en: To return to a place or situation that you were in before.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放回了书架。
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.ex: My friend always backs up my ideas in meetings.
words.ex_cn: 我的朋友总是在会议上支持我的想法。
words.en: To support someone or something; to make a copy of computer data to protect against loss.

words.ex: The price of apples will go up next week.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的价格将在下周上涨。
words.en: If a price, amount, or level goes up, it becomes higher or greater than it was.

words.tr: phrase. 下沉；坠落；下降；被接受；传下去；被咽下
words.ex: The sun goes down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在傍晚落下。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower place or position; to decrease in size, amount, or intensity; to be accepted or believed; to happen or take place.

words.ex: He goes east to find the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他往东走去找日出。
words.en: Move in the direction of the rising sun.

words.ex: The sun goes west in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在傍晚西下。
words.en: To move or travel towards the west; to fail or be destroyed; to die.

words.tr: phrase. 走下坡路；每况愈下
words.ex: His business started to go south after the recession.
words.ex_cn: 经济衰退后，他的生意开始走下坡路。
words.en: To deteriorate or fail, especially suddenly or unexpectedly.

words.ex: The ship decided to go north to avoid the storm.
words.ex_cn: 为了避开风暴，船决定北上。
words.en: To travel in a northerly direction.

words.ex: The book is on my left.
words.ex_cn: 书在我左边。
words.en: Positioned to the left side of someone, used literally or figuratively.

words.tr: 短语. 站在某人的右边；在某人右侧
words.ex: He was sitting on my right during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间他坐在我的右边。
words.en: To be positioned to the right side of someone.

words.ex: The park is directly opposite the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园就在学校正对面。
words.en: Directly opposite means exactly facing something or being completely different from something else.

words.ex: The cat likes to be in the corner of the room.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢待在房间的角落里。
words.en: Be situated at the intersection of two edges or surfaces, forming an angle.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼；底层；有利地位
words.ex: The shop is on the ground floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在底层。
words.en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is level or almost level with the ground outside.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.ex: The house has a small annex for storage.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个用于存放物品的小附属物。
words.en: To annex means to take control of a country, region, etc., especially by force; to add an area or region to a country, state, etc. : to take control of (a territory or place).

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.tr: phrase. 两个完全相同的建筑，双子建筑
words.ex: The twin building stands next to the school.
words.ex_cn: 双子楼紧挨着学校。
words.en: A pair of buildings that are similar in design and often connected or located close to each other.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: He walked up the stair to the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯到了二楼。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.tr:
n. 步；步骤；踏级；步伐；
v. 踩；踏；行走；
words.ex: He took a small step forward.
words.ex_cn: 他向前迈了一小步。
words.en: A step is an act or movement of putting one leg in front of the other in order to move forward, or a stage in a process.

words.ex: The books are on the shelf beside the aisle.
words.ex_cn: 书在过道旁边的架子上。
words.en: An aisle is a long narrow gap that people can walk along between rows of seats in a public building such as a church or between rows of shelves in a supermarket.

words.tr: phrase. 轮椅通道；供轮椅使用者通行的无障碍设施
words.ex: The building has wheelchair access.
words.ex_cn: 这栋建筑有轮椅通道。
words.en: Facilities or modifications designed to allow people in wheelchairs to enter and use a building or area.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: The car stopped at a crossroad.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A crossroad is a place where two roads meet and cross each other, or a point at which an important decision must be made.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.ex: He saw a fork on the road and chose the left path.
words.ex_cn: 他看到路上有个分叉，于是选择了左边的路。
words.en: A place where a road splits into two diverging paths.

words.ex: He drove his car on the t-road to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他开车走T形路以节省时间。
words.en: A type of road junction, often found in the UK, where three roads meet, forming a 'T' shape, with one road ending at the intersection.

words.ex: The bird will fly over the river.
words.ex_cn: 鸟会飞过河流。
words.en: To travel through the air above something, typically in an aircraft or as a bird.

words.ex: Go straight across the street to find the park.
words.ex_cn: 直走穿过街道就能找到公园。
words.en: Continue forward without turning.

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过了门。
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.ex: He goes on talking even when no one listens.
words.ex_cn: 即使没人听，他还是继续说。
words.en: To continue an activity or process, especially after a pause or interruption.

words.tr: phrase. 前进； 进行；赞同
words.ex: The car went along the road slowly.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓慢地沿着路前进。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something, especially a plan or activity; to agree with or support an idea, proposal, etc.

words.ex: Wait here till you meet your friend.
words.ex_cn: 在这里等着，直到你遇见你的朋友。
words.en: Until the time when you encounter or reach someone.

words.w: be the first from the right
words.uk: biː ðə fɜːst frɒm ðə raɪt
words.us: biː ðə fɜːrst frʌm ðə raɪt
words.ex: He was standing in the line and he was the first from the right.
words.ex_cn: 他站在队伍中，是右边第一个。
words.en: Occupy the position that is farthest to the right in a line or sequence.

words.w: be the second from the left
words.uk: biː ðə ˈsekənd frɒm ðə left
words.us: biː ðə ˈsekənd frʌm ðə left
words.ex: In the photo, she is the second from the left.
words.ex_cn: 在照片中，她是左边第二个。
words.en: Occupy the position that is second from the leftmost end in a line or sequence.

words.ex: The storage room is located behind the main building.
words.ex_cn: 储藏室位于主楼的后面。
words.en: To be situated at the back of something or someone.

words.w: be on the corner of A Street and B Street
words.tr: 短语. 位于A街和B街的拐角处
words.uk: bi ɒn ðə ˈkɔːnər əv ə striːt ænd biː striːt
words.us: bi ɑːn ðə ˈkɔːrnər əv ə striːt ænd biː striːt
words.ex: The café is on the corner of A Street and B Street.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆位于A街和B街的拐角处。
words.en: Located at the point where two streets meet or intersect.
